name: Premier Plastics
old_description: Designed for Business - Engineered for Flexibility - Focused on Customer Satisfaction
about:
Premier Plastics operates from Omaha, Nebraska, where it was founded in 1983 by the owners of Herman’s Engraving, a local tool and die shop that built injection molds for agriculture, housing, and automotive markets. The company was acquired in 2018 by Ted Sondgeroth, who serves as president and has since invested in personnel and capital to expand its national reach.

The shop specializes in custom injection molding, offering insert molding, tight-tolerance work, short runs, and difficult-to-mold parts. Its in-house engineering team supports product development from prototyping and design through tooling and material selection, with a focus on engineered resins for metal-to-plastic conversions. Secondary operations include assembly, packaging, warehousing, vendor-managed inventory, and just-in-time delivery.

Premier serves a broad range of B2B customers across automotive, agricultural, aviation, construction, energy, medical, transportation, utilities, sports and recreation, toys and learning products, and health care. It works with companies that have no molding experience as well as large firms seeking flexible capacity or overflow production.

The company says it differentiates itself by taking on “tough” jobs that other molders avoid, emphasizing direct access to decision-makers—Sondgeroth personally evaluates each inquiry—and maintaining ISO 9001:2015 certification to ensure consistent quality.
